verdict.rationale: Swell documents a Backend API with authentication by store ID and secret key, separate test and live keys, official Node and PHP libraries, and per-resource reference pages (products, stock, purchase links). It also offers a runtime schema-introspection call, which suits AI-driven use. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404, and there is no llms.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.
authenticate with basic auth using your store ID as the username and a secret key as the password
secret keys prefixed sk_test_ route requests to your store's test environment, while sk_live_ keys target live data.
One call returns a store’s whole schema at runtime: every model—standard, merchant custom and app-installed alike—with field types and relationships.
Stock adjustments are used to keep track of inventory changes over time.
